outcome: Give game studio cto / live operations director a governed method to improve economy inflation variance by cohort using virtual currency sources, sinks and player inventories, with final decisions…
overview: Game Economy Inflation Monitoring addresses telemetry is noisy or missing, so operators spend time interpreting unrelated warnings in gaming and esports operations. The first proof of value uses virtual currency sources, sinks and player inventories. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is economy inflation variance by cohort, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: virtual currency sources, sinks and player inventories; define economy inflation variance by cohort and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Game Studio CTO / Live Operations Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including inject sensor failures, stale data and dependency loss into the pilot.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
